label: ordinary unstructured LLM review
specimen_set_rule: Use the same specimen ids, labels, pass_threshold, and good/bad split as the frozen source suite. If a specimen differs, the row must mark specimen_set_difference and cannot be merged into the four-arm claim.

allowed_context: question: should this claim be accepted as stated?

metric_mapping.false_accept_rate: bad rows where accept_claim_as_stated is true or score >= pass_threshold
metric_mapping.false_reject_rate: good rows where accept_claim_as_stated is false and score < pass_threshold
metric_mapping.structural_detection_rate: bad rows where fatal_flaw_identified is true under the same semantic adjudication rule used by the frozen benchmark
metric_mapping.exploit_detection_rate: alias of structural_detection_rate for suite compatibility

required_import_provenance.model: non-empty model identifier for the ordinary reviewer
required_import_provenance.timestamp: one of timestamp, reviewed_at, or created_at
required_import_provenance.prompt: one of prompt_sha256, prompt_hash, prompt_path, or prompt
required_import_provenance.provider_runtime: one of provider, runtime, or provider_runtime

prompt_binding_rule: Imported rows must bind to the exact reviewer prompt generated for the selected specimen and source run. A prompt_sha256 or prompt_hash must match the runner-generated prompt hash; a prompt literal or readable prompt_path must hash to the same value. Relative prompt_path values are resolved from the import JSON file directory first.
upgrade_rule: Only add D_ordinary_review to artifact_backed_arms after results.json, metrics_summary.json, ordinary_review_freeze_manifest.json, review prompt text, prompt hash binding, model id, review timestamp, and provider/runtime provenance are frozen under benchmarks/constraint_memory/runs/<run_id>, and ordinary_review_freeze_manifest.json reports can_promote_to_frozen_suite=true.
demotion_rule: If D_ordinary_review matches the hardened arms on false accepts, false rejects, and structural detection, demote the evaluator-hardening claim to claim-discipline/read-model evidence rather than reviewer-strength evidence.
non_claims: this contract is not a completed run
this contract is not evidence that ordinary review is weaker than deterministic gates
this contract does not make the current suite a four-arm benchmark
